reuse_decisions.non_reuse_reason: The group is a weak co-mention of Mathlib.NumberTheory.FLT.Basic. THM-M-0133 records the same root definition and partial or conditional candidates, but no accepted unconditional FermatLastTheorem body. Intake takes no proof credit and no provider acceptance transfers.

The group is a weak FLT.Proof module co-mention. The inspected external root candidate has a transitive proof gap and is outside the pinned local closure, so there is no reusable accepted proof body and no intake proof claim.

The group is a weak Mathlib.NumberTheory.FLT.Three co-mention. The exponent-three theorem is a restricted branch and cannot discharge the all-exponent FLT root; intake records it only as a later audit lead.

The group is a weak Mathlib.NumberTheory.FLT.Four co-mention. It offers an exponent-four body and a conditional root composer, neither of which is an unconditional all-exponent root or relevant proof credit for intake.

The group is a weak FltRegular.FltRegular co-mention. Its candidate covers regular primes only and cannot close arbitrary odd primes or the full root; intake imports neither proof body nor provider acceptance.

closure_audit.boundary: There are no direct or transitive hard parents and no reuse hints. All five weak shared-module groups were decided without reuse. This does not assert mathematical independence or transfer acceptance.
